title: 2022年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 In 2020, the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to the World Food Programme (WFP).

P2 Why a Nobel Prize for the WFP, and why now? In 2019, the WFP assisted nearly 100 million people in 88 countries. It is the safety net for those who fall off the edge of existence. It is a response to solving the problem of food instability. Its Nobel Prize reminds us all of the moral hazard in imagining that the poor and vulnerable are somebody else's problem.

P3 The WFP has been around since 1961 and has been the global coordinator of nationally based efforts to avoid disasters with food aid. Despite decades of effort to eliminate hunger, the latest estimate is that about 11% of people on the planet (about 820 million people) are suffering daily undernourishment. Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped despite gains through the 1990s and 2000s.

P4 Developed countries sometimes offer food and aid to developing ones, but at a price. One American philosopher stated that addressing the needs of the poor and vulnerable is about more than money—it is mostly about creating conditions under which prosperity and opportunity can thrive. When aid is offered with heavy conditions attached, like loan repayment or food for resources, it often widens the gap between rich and poor and sustains the old world order. This is why the work of the WFP is so vital.

P5 The scientific community, however, can provide a helping hand to the WFP. By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger, scientists can help reduce these problems. By making its voice heard, science can lead by example. The ability to overcome food shortages that must be built into some of the poorest countries will not come from loans from wealthy countries, which may have food problems of their own, or world economic institutions. This ability will be built upon self-confident people using open and shared scientific knowledge to pull themselves out of their misery.

questions.q: What does the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize make us realize?
options: More and more people in the world are suffering from starvation.
All of us can be affected by food instability one way or another.
It is hazardous to leave millions of people poor and vulnerable.
It is morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize make us realize? 是用 What 提问的具体内容题，问的是文中明示的某句话，不涉及推断或主旨。

【拆句】主干是 What does ... make us realize，the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize 是 动名词短语作主语，winning 由所有格 the WFP's 修饰、of 短语补足对象；理解上等价 于"世界粮食计划署获诺贝尔和平奖这件事让我们认识到什么"。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。 51. What does the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize make us realize? A) More and more people in the world are suffering from starvation. B) All of us can be affected by food instability one way or another. C) It is hazardous to leave millions of people poor and vulnerable. D) It is morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business.

【定位】Its Nobel Prize reminds us all of the moral hazard in imagining that the poor and vulnerable are somebody else's problem. 它（世界粮食计划署）获诺贝尔和平奖一事提醒我们所有人：把贫困者与脆弱群体想成是别 人的问题，是一种道德上的危险。

【选项】A) 答非所问 More and more people in the world are suffering from starvation. 说的是饥饿人 数在增加，这只是 P3 中的一项数据陈述，并非诺贝尔奖让我们意识到的道德层面的 道理。 B) 无中生有 All of us can be affected by food instability one way or another. 称所有人都会以某 种方式受食物不稳定影响，原文从未做此论断；P2 强调的是不能把扶贫当别人的事，而 非"每个人都会饿肚子"。 C) 偷换概念 It is hazardous to leave millions of people poor and vulnerable. 说"让人陷入贫困 是危险的"，把"危险"指向贫困者的处境；而原文 the moral hazard in imagining that ... somebody else's problem 中危险指的是"把扶贫想成别人的事"这种道德态度，主语 错位。 D) ✓ 正确 the moral hazard in imagining that the poor and vulnerable are somebody else's problem ↔ morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business 预判要求的两个关键义素"道德层面"与"不该认为帮穷人与己无关"都在 It is morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business. 里齐备，匹配最严丝合缝。 关于世界粮食计划署消除饥饿的努力,我们了解到什么? A) 它已经确保了数百万人的充足粮食供应。 B) 尽管取得了进展,但距离目标仍然遥远。 C) 它在应对自然灾害方面做得很好。 D) 它正在防止全球范围内的饥饿发生。

questions.q: What do we learn about the WFP's effort to eliminate hunger?
options: It has ensured a sufficient food supply to millions.
It is still far from its goal despite the progress made.
It has done a good job in combating natural disasters.
It is preventing starvation occurring on a global scale.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about ... 问的是关于某一具体话题的明示信息，答案应是原文对该话题 的直接陈述。

【拆句】WFP's effort to eliminate hunger 是 about 的宾语；effort 后接动词不定式 to eliminate hunger 作后置定语，相当于"为消除饥饿所做的努力"。整句无陷阱。 52. What do we learn about the WFP's effort to eliminate hunger? A) It has ensured a sufficient food supply to millions. B) It is still far from its goal despite the progress made. C) It has done a good job in combating natural disasters. D) It is preventing starvation occurring on a global scale.

【定位】Despite decades of effort to eliminate hunger, the latest estimate is that about 11% of people on the planet (about 820 million people) are suffering daily undernourishment. Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped despite gains through the 1990s and 2000s. 尽管已为消除饥饿付出了数十年的努力，最新估计仍有约 11%（约 8.2 亿人）正在遭受日 常营养不良。尽管 20 世纪 90 年代和 21 世纪头十年取得过进展，减少营养不良的进展已经 停止。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 It has ensured a sufficient food supply to millions. 称已确保数百万人的充足食物， 原文 11% of people ... are suffering daily undernourishment 恰恰相反——8.2 亿人 仍营养不良，谈不上已确保充足供给。 B) ✓ 正确 Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped despite gains through the 1990s and 2000s ↔still far from its goal despite the progress made 预判要求的"取得过进展"与"目标未达"两要素，分别由 despite the progress made 与 still far from its goal 一一承接，且语气与原文同样冷静客观，匹配最优。 C) 答非所问 It has done a good job in combating natural disasters. 把话题偏移到自然灾害，P3 谈的是消除饥饿、营养不良，未对该机构在自然灾害方面的表现下结论。 D) 过度推断 It is preventing starvation occurring on a global scale. 称正在全球范围内阻止饥饿 发生，原文 Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped 明确说进展已停 滞，更未给出该机构在阻止全球饥饿发生。 当粮食援助以有偿方式提供时会发生什么? A) 富人会变得更富,穷人会变得更穷。 B) 更多的人会愿意加入这项努力。 C) 更多的粮食将提供给有需要的人。 D) 救援努力的可持续性将降低。

questions.q: What will happen when food aid is offered at a price?
options: The rich will become richer and the poor poorer.
More people will be willing to join in the effort.
More food will be made available to the needy.
The relief effort will be rendered less sustainable.
questions.explain:
【判型】What will happen when food aid is offered at a price? 询问的是某条件下的具体后果， 文中应有明示的结果句。

【拆句】主干 What will happen，when 引导时间状语从句 when food aid is offered at a price， 从句采用被动语态 is offered；at a price 是固定搭配，意为"有代价地、附带条件地"，不 是字面"以一个价格"。基础薄弱考生若按字面理解 at a price 易跑偏，需把它当短语整体 记住。 53. What will happen when food aid is offered at a price? A) The rich will become richer and the poor poorer. B) More people will be willing to join in the effort. C) More food will be made available to the needy. D) The relief effort will be rendered less sustainable.

【定位】When aid is offered with heavy conditions attached, like loan repayment or food for resources, it often widens the gap between rich and poor and sustains the old world order. 当援助被附加沉重条件（例如要求偿还贷款或以资源换食物）时，它往往会拉大贫富差距并 维持旧有的世界秩序。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 widens the gap between rich and poor ↔The rich will become richer and the poor poorer 预判中"贫富差距更大"的核心义素，恰好被 richer ... poorer 比较级并列对偶句精确锁 定，且与定位句方向、程度完全一致。 B) 无中生有 More people will be willing to join in the effort. 称会有更多人愿意加入援助行动， 原文未做此推断，P4 的结果聚焦在贫富差距与旧秩序，与此选项无关。 C) 与原文相反 More food will be made available to the needy. 称会有更多食物送达需要的人，与 P4 强调附条件援助的负面后果（差距拉大、旧秩序延续）方向相反。 D) 偷换概念 The relief effort will be rendered less sustainable. 把后果转到"援助行动可持续性降 低"，原文未讨论可持续性，只说附条件援助维持旧秩序、扩大差距，未对援助本身能否 持续下结论。 科学家如何帮助应对贫困和饥饿? A) 通过与世界经济机构密切合作。 B) 通过与贫困国家的同行分享专业知识。 C) 通过在发展中国家建立更多的粮食研究项目。 D) 通过在遭受营养不良的人群中建立自尊。

questions.q: How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger?
options: By collaborating closely with world economic institutions.
By sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations.
By setting up more food research programs in developing countries.
By building self-respect in people suffering from undernutrition.
questions.explain:
【判型】How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger? 以 How 询问途径，文中通常 以 by 短语或具体动作句给出明示答案。

【拆句】How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger? 中 help 后接动词原形 cope （省略 to 的动词不定式），相当于"帮助应对"；structure 平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger, scientists can help reduce these problems. 通过与最易陷入贫困和饥饿的国家的同行分享农业和气候知识，科学家可以帮助减少这些 问题。 54. How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger? A) By collaborating closely with world economic institutions. B) By sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations. C) By setting up more food research programs in developing countries. D) By building self-respect in people suffering from undernutrition.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 By collaborating closely with world economic institutions. 称与世界经济机构紧密合 作，P5 提到 world economic institutions 时是否定语气——说该能力不会来自这些机 构，并未让科学家与之合作。 B) ✓ 正确 sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger ↔sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations 预判中三个要素"分享""知识/专业""贫困国家同行"在 By sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations 中一一对应，结构与原文方式状语完全平行。 C) 无中生有 By setting up more food research programs in developing countries. 称在发展中 国家设立更多食品研究项目，原文 P5 仅讲分享知识，未提建立研究项目。 D) 偷换概念 By building self-respect in people suffering from undernutrition. 称在营养不良的 人身上建立自尊，原文 self-confident people using open and shared scientific knowledge 谈的是"自信的人借科学知识自救"——是结果导向的论断，并非给科学家的 方法；且 self-respect（自尊）与 self-confident（自信）也并不等同。 作者在文章结尾试图传达什么信息? A) 富裕国家应该首先解决自己的粮食问题。 B) 富裕国家在提供粮食援助方面应该更加慷慨。 C) 贫穷国家应该增强自身解决粮食短缺的能力。 D) 世界经济机构应该在抗击饥饿方面发挥更大作用。
